definitions.explanation: Having characteristics of the modern era; reflecting modern standards, technology, or ways of thinking. Often implies progress and advancement.

examples.japanese: {近代的|きんだいてき}な{建物|たてもの}が{並|なら}んでいる。
{近代的|きんだいてき}な{設備|せつび}が{整|ととの}っている。
この{街|まち}は{古|ふる}い{町並|まちな}みと{近代的|きんだいてき}なビルが{共存|きょうぞん}している。
examples.english: In this city, old townscapes and modern buildings coexist.

notes:
USAGE:
Describes things that are modern in style, technology, or thinking, often with a positive nuance of progress. Used with な when modifying nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近代的|きんだいてき}な{都市|とし} (modern city)
- {近代的|きんだいてき}な{生活|せいかつ} (modern lifestyle)
- {近代的|きんだいてき}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた} (modern way of thinking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {現代的|げんだいてき}: contemporary (more focused on the present era)
- {先進的|せんしんてき}: advanced, cutting-edge
